review_evidence: README identifies l4v as the L4.verified repository of formal specifications and Isabelle/HOL proofs for the seL4 microkernel, with abstract, Haskell, machine, C, capDL, take-grant and refinement/security developments.
The reviewed unit has 1,883 current-primary Isabelle theories spanning specifications, refinement, access-control/infoflow proofs, system initialization, libraries and C/assembly proof tooling.

Example/test/tool-named theories were conservatively retained: inspected paths include separation-logic examples, Eisbach/ML tactic tests and proof/refinement examples, which exercise or state formal proof-tool semantics rather than forming a demonstrably lossless generated/report layer.
summary: Retain the full seL4 l4v Isabelle unit, including proof-tool examples and regression theories, because the repository is itself a large formal specification and verification development.

review_evidence: Verified all 155 paths from the brief exist under port-sources/seL4__l4v (no missing files).

`sed 's#/[^/]*$##' filelist | sort -u` -> 36 distinct directories, all within lib/, proof/{access-control,crefine,dpolicy,drefine,infoflow,invariant-abstract,refine}(+arch subdirs), spec/{abstract,design,machine}(+arch subdirs), plus tools/c-parser/testfiles.

Read in full the three smallest files: proof/invariant-abstract/ARM_HYP/ArchCrunchSetup_AI.thy (584 bytes) -- a real `crunch_ignore` proof-automation directive inside `theory...context Arch...end`; proof/refine/AARCH64/ArchEmptyFail.thy (781 bytes) -- a real `lemma empty_fail_lookupIPCBuffer` plus a locale `interpretation`; proof/refine/RISCV64/ArchMove_R.thy (1518 bytes) -- a real `definition ppn_len` and `lemma get_pt_mapM_x_lower` with a full Isar proof.

Read tools/c-parser/testfiles/fncall.thy (4901 bytes, the only file outside lib/proof/spec) in full: a genuine C-parser regression-test theory with `primrec fac`, `install_C_file`, multiple `lemma (in ...)` Hoare-triple proofs about parsed C functions f/g/h/i/fact, and ML round-trip assertions -- real formal verification content, not a stub.

Ran `grep -cE` for the Isabelle declaration-keyword set (theorem|lemma|definition|primrec|fun|inductive|locale|class|interpretation|axiomatization|datatype|record|abbreviation|corollary|schematic_goal|specification|instantiation|typedef|type_synonym) over all 155 files: exactly 1 file matched zero times (ArchCrunchSetup_AI.thy, already read above and confirmed to hold a real executable `crunch_ignore` command, which is outside the pure-import candidate class).

Read proof/refine/CNodeInv_R.thy (360083 bytes, the largest file in the unit) head: genuine `arch_requalify_consts/facts`, `unbundle`, and `lemma corres_disj_abs` content with real Isar proofs about CNode invocation refinement.

Read spec/design/skel/ARM_HYP/Hardware_H.thy (2985 bytes) and spec/design/m-skel/AARCH64/MachineTypes.thy (5090 bytes) in full: both are genuine Isabelle theories mixing real declarations (`datatype fpu_state`, `record machine_state`, `axiomatization irq_oracle`, `type_synonym`, `definition init_machine_state`) with `#INCLUDE_HASKELL` literate-Haskell-extraction directives used throughout seL4's executable design spec -- not generated data dumps, not pure aggregators.

Sampled the head of one file from each of six previously-unread directories (proof/dpolicy/Dpolicy.thy, proof/drefine/Finalise_DR.thy, proof/access-control/ADT_AC.thy, proof/infoflow/refine/AARCH64/ArchADT_IF_Refine_C.thy, spec/machine/ARM_HYP/MachineOps.thy, lib/Word_Lib/Word_Lemmas_Internal.thy): every sample opens with a real copyright header, real imports, and genuine locale/definition/lemma content with substantive prose documentation.

Ran `grep -lE '\bsorry\b'` over all 155 files: 0 matches. Ran `grep -cE '\boops\b'`: only lib/Corres_UL.thy (4) and tools/c-parser/testfiles/fncall.thy (2) match, both large genuine files where `oops` marks an intentionally discarded exploratory proof attempt (a stronger, safe form of proof-abandonment than `sorry` since it admits no theorem into the theory) -- an ordinary engineering artifact, not evidence of junk.
summary: Surveyed the checkout (port-sources/seL4__l4v): confirmed all 155 review-list files exist as .thy files spanning lib, lib/Word_Lib, proof/{access-control,crefine,dpolicy,drefine,infoflow,invariant-abstract,refine}(+arch subdirs AARCH64/ARM/ARM_HYP/RISCV64/X64), spec/{abstract,design,machine}(+arch subdirs), and one outlier tools/c-parser/testfiles/fncall.thy -- consistent with the prior review's summary that this is the seL4 l4v Isabelle formal specification and verification development (abstract/executable/C specs plus their layered refinement, access-control, information-flow, and CRefine proofs across five hardware architectures). Ran a full Isabelle-declaration-keyword grep over all 155 files; only one file (ArchCrunchSetup_AI.thy) matched none, and it was read in full: it holds a real `crunch_ignore` command, an executable proof-automation directive, not a pure import. Read the one file outside the main proof/spec/lib tree (fncall.thy, a C-parser regression test) in full: it contains real `theory`/`primrec`/`locale`/`lemma` declarations proving Hoare-logic specifications about parsed C functions -- genuine formal content, matching the prior review's note to retain proof-tool examples and regression theories. Sampled the smallest files across several directories and the head of the largest file plus two Haskell-literate '#INCLUDE_HASKELL' design-skeleton files; all carry genuine Isabelle/HOL declarations. Checked for sorry/oops proof-abandonment markers: no sorry anywhere; oops appears only in lib/Corres_UL.thy and fncall.thy, both large genuine files where oops marks an intentionally abandoned exploratory proof attempt, not evidence of junk. No exclusions.
